items.context: Can you describe the issue you are facing?
What problem are you experiencing with your connection?

items.text: I am not getting any network signal since morning
My calls keep dropping every few minutes
Internet speed is very slow and sometimes it disconnects
There is no network coverage in my office building
Whenever I try to call someone the call just ends immediately
Data connection fails frequently and I cannot browse

items.context: Can you tell me about your internet connectivity problem?
items.text: The internet is very slow in my area since yesterday

items.context: Where do you notice the call drop issues?
items.text: Call drops happen mostly when I move to different parts of the city

items.context: Is there any specific place where network doesn't work?
items.text: I have no network signal at my home but it works fine outside

items.context: What does your phone display when the call fails?
items.text: My phone shows full signal but calls fail to connect at times
For the last two days I have been experiencing no network signal at my residence even though others nearby are getting good reception
Everytime I try to use mobile data my internet speed reduces drastically and the connection drops frequently making it very difficult to use

items.context: Have you tried using a different sim card in your phone to check the signal?
items.text: I am using a new sim card but even after activating it the network does not come properly in my area which is quite frustrating

items.context: Can you describe your call experience and frequency of call drops?
items.text: The call quality is very bad and the call drops happen multiple times in a day especially when I travel between locations

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: no_network - has no signal, call drops or slow internet
Language: Indian English, Latin script.
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 18 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'yes please', 'tomorrow', 'card ending 4321'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 6 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 4 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
